# MARKDKBERRY DOT COM NOTES

May 2026

I never had much luck with Klein until I used Allisonexdr head swap and it beat the ass off QWEN in a big way not just result but in speed.


**CONCLUSION**: start with 4 steps, lcm, cfg 1, and without the speed up loras, and use the klein 9b fp8 model not the GGUF (only for speed, quality is about the same).

---

KLEIN excels at most tasks the only thing it fails dismally at is camera angle changes. For that use QWEN with multi camera angle lora.

---

## KLEIN PROMPTS THAT WORK:

`replace the head of the man on the left in image 1 with the head of the man from image 2.`

`use the man in image 1 to create a passport photo with grey background and neutral expression.`

`use the coat the man is wearing in image 1 to create a product display photo of the coat on a grey background` - *(include "just the coat" if you get unwanted head)*

`remove the man's head from the product photo in image 1. change nothing else.`

`remove the people from this image leaving only the inside of the elevator`

`replace the jacket of the man in the centre of image 1 with the jacket from image 2.`

`replace the red doors from image 1 with the black doors in image 2.`

`completely remove the man from image 1 and replace him with the woman from image 2` - *(any weird limbs just change seed usually sorts it).*

`make a full length photograph of the black woman in image 2 wearing a skin-tight leopard skin dress and leopard skin high-heel shoes on a white background` - *(used with "empty image" node at 1:2 aspect ratio in the image 1 slot)*

`three woman walking toward the viewer in a hotel lobby, reflection can be seen in the marble floor, and the light and shade create a professional photograph for a fashion shoot. dont change the background scenery.` - *(blending in three women I composited into a shot using Krita)*

`turn the woman around 180 degrees` - *(used on character 2:1 full length body with white bg, worked very well to get the back of her)*

`turn the woman 90 degrees side view of her profile` - *(used on character 2:1 full length body with white bg, worked very well to get the side view of her)*

`fix the lighting and shadows on the woman and the floor where she is standing in pose so she blends into the background scene`

### Multiple People:

to swap people out, make sure same number of people are in similar gender order in the shot, and then try this, I use front-facing full-body standing characters on white background in image 2 regardless of what they are doing in image 1 (if it fails it will usually fail by using less people in the swap and repeating them but I often get good result with four):

 `replace the four people in image 1 with the four people from image 2. maintain lighting and position of people in image 1`. 

when putting multiple people into a new environment, try taking a image of the group on any background how you want them positioned, and put that in image 1 slot *(make sure its the final aspect ratio you require as it will be used for the sizing)*. Then add the environment you want them to be put into in image 2. I found this way around managed the people better in many runs than putting the people in image 2. not sure why. 

then use this prompt: `replace the background of image 1 with image 2`

to relight them after: `relight the people in image 1 to blend in with the background`

### Face and body pose flipping:

use Krita to flip the poses *(Klein doesnt understand left from right for a direction to look in)* then load your people into image 1 and just the poses skeletons with alpha background in image 2 *(I believe Klein is trained on pose skeletons so you can get this working without any prompt but also can use)* -
`Reposition the two people from image 1 to match the exact poses and body orientations shown in the pose‑skeletons in image 2`  

### To outpaint:

`outpaint the white area to fill out the image` , or create size canvas you want in Krita and fill the empty space with red (or a color not in the image) then take it to Klein and prompt:

`remove the red paddings on the side and show what's behind them`
